set.frontline_archer.technical: You have a 25% chance to exhaust the enemy and reduce their DEF by 60. In Assault, the Blacksmith has a 100% chance to grant you +5 ATK and +5 DEF per level.
set.ghoul.technical: You have a 44% chance to pressure the enemy and remove 10 ATK and 10 DEF. ASSAULT — HARD COUNTER to the Clone: when you encounter it, you always remove 3000 ATK and 5000 DEF for that structure fight.
set.grove_squire.technical: Until you have dealt more than 300 damage, you keep growing: +30 HP, +10 ATK, +10 DEF, and +3 AGI. ASSAULT — HARD COUNTER to the Ornamental Scarecrow: when you encounter it, you neutralize it and gain +3000 ATK and +2000 DEF for the rest of the Assault.
set.living_bait.technical: Challenge: your DEF is set to 0 at the start. Assault: the attacker's DEF is also set to 0.
set.primordial_damned.human: Evil devours every defense: in Challenge and Assault, all DEF is converted into ATK.
set.primordial_damned.technical: Challenge/Assault: converts 100% of your DEF into ATK and reduces DEF to 0.
set.relic_seeker.technical: During a Challenge, you have a 24% chance to find a relic that grants +15 AGI, +150 HP, +60 DEF, or +250 ATK. ASSAULT — HARD COUNTER to the Little Cannon: if you target the Little Cannon, you gain +7000 DEF for the Assault with 100% certainty.

set.shadow_assassin.technical: ASSAULT — COUNTER to the Centralized Healing Center: when the Center tries to heal, you make an 80% check followed by a 70% check to turn its healing into structure damage. The value is 3 damage per Center level; on the first effect, structures below 50 HP are preserved.
set.sky_controller.technical: Challenge: at the end of each turn, if you gained HP during that turn, gain ATK equal to half the HP recovered and DEF equal to half the HP recovered.
set.worm_duelist.technical: COMBAT and ASSAULT: the first worm is guaranteed; then you have an 11% chance to eat another, repeating until you fail. Each worm grants +1 ATK, +1 DEF, and +20 HP.
